adaptations.scope: Last numbered name slot is display text; add slot 1 when translating a single-slot name, retaining slot 0 identity.
adaptations.changes: Require contiguous numbered slots; preserve original line numbers, attribute order and unrelated commands.

adaptations.scope: Set or add a display name attribute on a recognized speaker tag.
adaptations.changes: Preserve tag identity, voice parameters and trailing comments; retain explicit speaker identification, variable protection and shared-command conflict checks.

adaptations.scope: Translate ES.CHAR.NAME argument 2, preserve argument 1 identity; support complete single-string EVAL literals.
adaptations.changes: Restrict to verified v482 descriptors; reject dynamic expressions and unexpected name parameter layouts; append changed values without moving the original pool.

adaptations.scope: Extract and replace caption text from numbered choice command records.
adaptations.changes: Preserve command prefixes, record identity, non-text pool bytes and pending speaker association; reparse translated rows.

adaptations.scope: Extract and replace the first simple savetext parameter.
adaptations.changes: Replace only the original character span and retain every subsequent argument; reject unsupported nested parameters.

validation: Synthetic parser/writer roundtrips, variable-length replacements, independent reparsing, and preservation checks; no game execution or display verification.
